name: Views Conditional Text
description: Show Views header/footer/empty text based on query results.
project_description:
Views Conditional Text adds a Query-only (conditional text) mode to Views displays.

 
When this mode is enabled, the View query is executed normally, but

 no fields, rows, exposed filters, pagers, or paths are rendered .

This allows site builders to display conditional content using

 Header, Footer, or Empty text areas only.

 Key Features 
 
 Adds a Query-only mode toggle per View display 
 Runs the View query without rendering rows or fields 
 Fully suppresses exposed filters and pagers 
 Allows Header, Footer, and Empty text to render normally 
 Works with Page and Block displays 
 No global configuration required 
 
 Typical Use Cases 
 
 Display informational or status messages based on query results 
 Show conditional banners or notices without rendering content lists 
 Use Views as a lightweight data check instead of a renderer 
 
 How It Works 
 
The module integrates as a Views display extender .

When Query-only mode is enabled for a display:

 
 The View query still runs 
 Fields, rows, exposed forms, pagers, and paths are suppressed 
 Header, Footer, and Empty areas behave normally based on results 
 
 Notes 
 
 This module does not modify query logic or filters 
 It only affects rendering when explicitly enabled per display 
 Other Views displays remain completely unaffected
